title: How to Identify Your Skin Type: 3 Simple At-Home Tests
ex: Three easy at-home tests to identify your skin type (oily, dry, combination, normal or sensitive), plus a starter day and night routine for each.
rt: How to Identify Your Skin Type at Home | Mirc Glow
rd: How to identify your skin type at home with simple tests: the bare-face test, blotting paper test and a one-week check, plus a starter routine for each type.
keyword: how to identify your skin type
quick: Wash your face with a mild cleanser, pat dry, apply nothing and wait about an hour. Shine all over means oily, tightness or flakes mean dry, a shiny T-zone with normal cheeks means combination, and comfortable skin means normal. Skin that stings or reddens easily is also sensitive.
facts: The bare-face test takes about an hour.
Blotting paper shows where oil collects.
Sensitive skin can overlap with any skin type.
Skin type can shift with season, age and hormones.
